description: Synthetic: escrow ids, block hashes, block numbers and indexes are made up. Only the genesis hash is real (faucet GET /chain and tclk/flop/VERIFICATION.md). gateway-report.json is a made-up gateway receipt that says settled and names the escrow. The only chain page holds a made-up gateway.Settled event, which is not a hasStation escrow event. Neither is chain proof.
